description: This bar chart, from the paper "Breaking Bias, Building Bridges: Evaluation and Mitigation of Social Biases in LLMs via Contact Hypothesis," illustrates the bias percentage for three domains—Sports, Community, and Healthcare—before and after contact interventions, with each domain represented by a group of three stacked bars. The vertical axis, labeled "Bias Percentage," ranges from 0 to 70 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the three domains. Each group of bars is composed of three segments, corresponding to the categories defined in the legend: "No Contact Before" (solid gray), "Positive Contact Before" (solid red), and "Negative Contact Before" (solid light blue) for the pre-contact state, and "No Contact After" (diagonal gray), "Positive Contact After" (diagonal red), and "Negative Contact After" (diagonal blue) for the post-contact state. For the "Sports" domain, the "No Contact Before" bar reaches 45.42, the "Positive Contact Before" bar reaches 43.65, and the "Negative Contact Before" bar reaches 50.05; the "No Contact After" bar reaches 7.45, the "Positive Contact After" bar reaches 8.31, and the "Negative Contact After" bar reaches 8.33. For the "Community" domain, the "No Contact Before" bar reaches 38.08, the "Positive Contact Before" bar reaches 35.38, and the "Negative Contact Before" bar reaches 40.79; the "No Contact After" bar reaches 0.00, the "Positive Contact After" bar reaches 0.01, and the "Negative Contact After" bar reaches 0.00. For the "Healthcare" domain, the "No Contact Before" bar reaches 40.70, the "Positive Contact Before" bar reaches 37.51, and the "Negative Contact Before" bar reaches 46.73; the "No Contact After" bar reaches 0.00, the "Positive Contact After" bar reaches 0.01, and the "Negative Contact After" bar reaches 0.11. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and pattern coding.
